stops.name: Terme di Saturnia
stops.detail: The Terme di Saturnia constitute a thermal park of international importance in the Grosseto Maremma, formed by a hydrothermal spring that gushes at a constant temperature of 37.5 degrees.

stops.name: piscina sorgente
stops.detail: The water flow is almost 800 liters per second: this allows the source pool and the thermal park pools a complete replacement every 4 hours, 6 times a day, making it uncontaminated.

stops.name: Cascate del Mulino
stops.detail: The spring, in addition to supplying the aforementioned thermal park, also feeds the Cascate del Mulino downstream, which have free access and a lower water temperature.

stops.name: Saturnia
stops.detail: The complex is located in the locality of Follonata, near Saturnia, in the municipality of Manciano, in the province of Grosseto.

stops.name: via Clodia
stops.detail: Travelers stopped there while traveling along the Via Clodia and Roman Patricians chose it for their healthy holidays.
